description: Supply tweetId or url. tweetId takes precedence. Returns full text, author and engagement metadata, and ordered photo/video/GIF attachments. Each video also has a renderableAudios item whose renderConfig produces an M4A of its audio: the HLS audio rendition when the playlist has one, otherwise the audio of the medium-quality MP4. Text-only tweets succeed with contents=[] and metadata.post.isTextOnly=true. Deleted or private tweets return an error. The former prototype postId parameter is replaced by tweetId. Group: Twitter-Tweet. Billing per call: 1 Credits.

lang.description: Preferred page language, passed in the page URL, Accept-Language header and media request headers. Defaults to en. Does not translate tweet text.
lang.title: lang

tweetId.description: Numeric tweet ID. Required unless url is supplied.
tweetId.title: tweetId

url.description: An http(s) X/Twitter status URL or t.co short link. Photo/video suffixes and query strings are supported. Required unless tweetId is supplied.
url.title: url

name: get_twitter_v3_post_details
title: Get Tweet Details
